posts.title: How to Fix Audio Pop with Pipewire on Linux
posts.description: A harsh popping sound at the start and end of audio playback in Linux was driving me crazy. This is on a Dell XPS13 laptop and the issue is the power saving subsystem. Here's how to resolve the issue using Pipewire (Wireplumber) on Arch Linux.

posts.title: Conditional Configuration for Hyprland
posts.description: Hyprland has no built-in support for conditional configuration. This makes me a bit sad as I like to maintain a single dotfile repo that works for more than one computer. Here's how I configure Hyprland based on hostname.

posts.title: How to use Twister to cycle test Zephyr devices
posts.description: Zephyr includes a test runner app called Twister. It has a dizzying number of features, and recently I wrote a script to configure the tool for my most-used operation: cycle testing on embedded devices.
